title: Austin Approves Electric Utility Rates
summary:
*   City leaders formally adopted new electric utility rates.
*   The decision to implement the new rates passed with a unanimous 7-0 vote.
*   This focused, special meeting concluded rapidly, adjourning after just 15 minutes.
